data.narrative:
Dream Security, a Series B defense and security company founded by Shalev Hulio, Sebastian Kurz, and Gil Dolev, has raised over $100M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 companies across the same sector and stage: 2 public peers (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms, including Allen Control Systems, Harmattan AI, Code Metal, Twenty, and Defense Unicorns.

The Stage-Progression method was deemed inapplicable after a sanity check flagged that the stated $3.0B post-money valuation implies a 30x multiple on total capital raised, inconsistent with typical Series B progression. The Peer-Median method, applied across 7 same-sector, same-stage comparables, yielded a median valuation of $1.0B, with a range spanning $300M to $2.2B. This peer set includes Allen Control Systems at $2.2B (high end) and represents the full spectrum of Series B valuations in defense tech.

The triangulated valuation range is $850M to $1.1B, with a midpoint of $1.0B, supported by a single applicable method. Key uncertainties include capital intensity relative to peers, revenue traction within the defense procurement cycle, and whether the company's specific competitive positioning warrants a premium or discount to median comparables. Additional disclosure of revenue or ARR would strengthen conviction in this range.
